title: Señorita Vega Transforms Paranormal Encounters into Horror-Rock Sensation with "I See Dead People"

/Señorita Vega Transforms Paranormal Experiences into Music with Latest Release

Horror-rock singer and songwriter Señorita Vega is channeling a lifetime of unusual and unsettling experiences into her new single, “I See Dead People.” The track reflects her reported encounters with the paranormal, blending elements of horror, rock, humor, and visual storytelling to narrate some of the strangest moments of her life.

Señorita Vega’s spooky journey began in childhood, characterized by her aversion to sleeping in darkness or being alone in a room, claims she attributed to seeing figures that others could not. She vividly recalls one instance where she woke her cousin in the night to share that an admired actress had appeared to her in the bathroom mirror and waved at her.

“There’s a woman staring at me right there. I don’t want to be alone with her,” she shared, addressing the fear that gripped her at such a young age.

A particularly harrowing experience marked her adolescence when she learned of a childhood friend’s death through a vivid dream before anyone had informed her. “I dreamed that I was marrying him. Suddenly, he turned to me, screaming, ‘No! I’m not dead!’ His face was deformed, and his mouth was unnaturally large, like the way ghosts are depicted in horror films. I woke up terrified,” she recounted, revealing the emotional turmoil that ensued after learning of his tragic fate.

Throughout her life, Señorita Vega reports a series of premonitory dreams and strange encounters, which have profoundly influenced her creative journey. One memorable incident occurred while she was watching a horror film with her then-boyfriend. “When the film ended, I immediately said, ‘I’m never watching this film again. There’s something really diabolically wrong with it. Can’t you feel the energy?’ As soon as I finished saying that, a glass sitting on a table literally exploded,” she described, noting the surprise and fear it generated.

Her fascination with the mysterious has guided her interests towards paranormal investigation and horror cinema, leading her to explore reportedly haunted locations. “My experiences made me travel to many of the most haunted places in the world, trying to communicate with spirits that are said to be trapped in these places. Now I use horror and the occult in my songs and music video aesthetics to depict some of my experiences,” she stated, reflecting on how her art serves as a form of therapy for past traumas.

“I See Dead People” offers a darkly comedic take on the iconic phrase from The Sixth Sense, transforming what could simply be a horror experience into a playful and empowering narrative. Accompanied by a music video that melds horror imagery with humor and parody, the single is part of Señorita Vega’s expanding repertoire themed around the supernatural and the oddities of life.

Through her music and social media presence, she aims to forge connections with those who have navigated similar unexplained phenomena, as well as engage with horror fans and audiences intrigued by the darkness in entertainment.

Señorita Vega is a Brazilian-born, UK-based artist recognized for her unique fusion of horror cinema, rock music, and striking visual storytelling. Her work continues to explore the eerie and macabre, captivating listeners and fans alike.
